definitions: To do something to make sure that one is not dreaming or imagining something, especially when something good or surprising has happened.
To feel a need to confirm the reality of a situation, often one that is very positive or unbelievable.
examples: She had to pinch herself to believe she'd won the lottery.
I keep pinching myself; I can't believe this is real.
He pinched himself to make sure he wasn't dreaming about the promotion.
